prompt: Generate a raised lava tile with a full 128x128 square base and a visibly 32px-high front wall, in top-down oblique game projection. Its surface should connect with identical neighboring tiles. Keep the logical footprint fixed as the top extends above the cell upper boundary. Deliver each sprite in a 192x320px frame with local projected ground anchor (96,248). Save original generated images, exact prompts, all references, processed sprites, result.json, and review previews in {{OUTPUT_DIR}}.

visualChecks.projection: Screen-aligned square grid; top and front readable; parallel edges, no depth-dependent scale or camera drift.
visualChecks.complete-art: Full silhouette and effects fit the declared frame; no clipped limbs or undeclared shadows.
visualChecks.anchor-placement: Ground/root location matches the guide independently of alpha bounds or visible toe tips.
visualChecks.visible-height: The front wall reads as 32px elevation; the object is not a flat ground swatch.
visualChecks.full-base: Opaque coverage spans the complete cell without corner gaps or taper.
visualChecks.lava-joins: Repeated molten channels/crust meet without obvious seams or lighting jumps.
visualChecks.source-faithfulness: Compare original generated sources with processed sprites and declared operations; no invented replacement art or unreported geometry fitting.
